name: Legacy of Dead

features.name: Multiple expanding symbols
features.description: Each scatter beyond three adds an additional expanding symbol for the free spins.

review:
Book of Dead, refined. Three scatters give ten free spins with one expanding symbol, four give two, and five give three – which makes those bigger triggers genuinely exciting.

With two or three expanding symbols, full-screen wins become far more likely than in Book of Dead, so the bonus has a higher floor. The base game is the classic book formula: ten lines, a wild-scatter, plenty of small hits. Top RTP 96.58% – check the casino's version.
pros: Higher default RTP than Book of Dead
cons: Very similar to Book of Dead
